annotations.title: Check a GTA 6 claim or rumor

description: Use this when someone asks whether one specific GTA 6 claim or rumor is true (use get_facts to browse the whole database instead). Looks the claim up and returns the closest entries with their status (confirmed, rumor, false and so on), the reason and the source. Returns no match rather than guessing when nothing is close.

claim.description: The claim in plain words, for example "GTA 6 is coming to PC at launch"
